decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures wallet provisioning, wallet purpose, and direct mint delivery for Transak fiat buyers.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already replaces one-click claiming with automatic wallet transfer, removes claim_interaction, and records the stated winner notifications.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already records that a Transak fiat buyer's confirmation email contains the mint number as the referral code.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures the certificate reading action, optional download, Transak confirmation-email requirement, email contents, and applicable scope.
The source describes rewards from coded referrals and does not change behavior for mints without a referral code.
The source repeats the existing $15 mint price and $5 referral commission but does not change the revenue split, founder share, fee treatment, or pool funding allocation.
Saying prize tickets are tied to the NFT or wallet does not change which counters, badges, or referral information must be visible in NFT metadata.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE already captures the read-only default, PDF.js viewer, dashboard and email entry points, and optional offline download.
The source does not change the identity of the minted asset; direct delivery to a Transak-created wallet is already represented by the fiat on-ramp Requirement.
The source's on-chain fair-randomness description is consistent with the existing Chainlink VRF selection requirement and does not replace or modify its method.
The source discusses draw frequency, tickets, and payout delivery but does not change how prize pools are funded.
The source contains no decision about secondary-sale royalties, their enforcement, or the flat $10 royalty amount.
